questions.q: Why is the built-in Account Owner field hidden on our record pages?
o: It reads as Stephen on nearly everything, so it is misleading
It was replaced by the Case owner field
It is only visible to administrators
questions.e: It was deliberately hidden during the 1 July 2026 view overhaul so nobody derives ownership from it. Sales Rep is the truth.

questions.q: Which of these are genuine duplicate records in our CRM today?
o: STL Technology Solutions twice, Qualcom twice, McLernons vs McLernon Computers, Touchstore vs TouchStore
questions.e: All four pairs are live. When several records match, use the one already holding the open opportunities and never split a rep's deals across twins.

questions.q: In our CRM, what does a Company record represent?
o: Any business we deal with, including suppliers and end users
Who we sell to: the reseller, system integrator, VAR, IT team or software vendor
The business the equipment is installed for
Only accounts that have placed an order
questions.e: We are trade-only. Companies are who we sell to and who pays the invoice. Who the kit is for is an End Customer.

questions.q: What is the Account Code on a company record?
o: The Intact A/C code, which joins the CRM record to the ERP
questions.e: It is the join key. Without it, what the account has actually bought can never be tied back to the CRM record.
